description: The HTTP route table — the project's routes, createCoreRouter's auto-CRUD and the plugins' (`origin`) — with method, mounted `fullPath`, handler, policies, middlewares, auth and where each is declared. With `pipeline: true`: what a request goes through, in Strapi's order, each step's status (`not-found-by-strapi`: Strapi throws at startup). Use it to explain a 401/403 or a startup error about a policy or middleware.

from.description: A path inside the project (the file you are editing; relative to its root with `project`), in a multi-project workspace.

path.description: Only routes matching this pattern, a part of it, or a concrete URL (`/api/articles/12`).

pipeline.description: Add each route's pipeline (needs method, path or handler; at most 20 routes).

project.description: A project name or root, when no path is at hand.

name: list_routes
title: List HTTP routes
